title: Enterprise AI startup Glide raises $80M Series C to automate sales operations
raw_summary: Glide, which builds AI copilots for B2B sales teams, announced an $80M Series C led by a top-tier VC at a $600M valuation. The company says its tools have cut sales-prep time by 35% for enterprise clients including three Fortune 500 companies, and plans to use the funding to expand into APAC markets.

title: McKinsey report: 72% of large enterprises now use generative AI in at least one business function
raw_summary: A new McKinsey survey of 1,200 executives found generative AI adoption has nearly doubled year over year, with marketing, customer service, and software development leading use cases. However, only 12% of companies report having scaled AI beyond pilot projects, citing data quality and change management as the top barriers.

title: OpenAI launches enterprise-focused model with built-in compliance controls for regulated industries
raw_summary: OpenAI introduced a new model tier aimed at banks, insurers, and healthcare firms, with audit logging, data residency options, and configurable content controls. Early customers include two large Indian private banks piloting the model for customer service and internal document review.

title: Amazon lays off 1,200 in cloud division as it shifts spending toward AI infrastructure
raw_summary: Amazon confirmed layoffs affecting roughly 1,200 employees in its AWS division, framing the move as a reallocation of resources toward AI chip development and data center buildout. The company says AI-related capital expenditure will rise 40% next year even as headcount in some legacy cloud teams shrinks.

title: Google DeepMind's new model cuts drug discovery simulation time from months to days
raw_summary: DeepMind published research showing its latest molecular simulation model can predict protein-ligand binding with pharma-grade accuracy in a fraction of the compute time of prior approaches. Two major pharmaceutical companies have already licensed the technology for early-stage drug screening.

title: Canva's new AI design assistant sparks debate over creative-agency pricing models
raw_summary: Canva rolled out an AI assistant that can generate full brand campaigns from a single prompt, prompting several mid-size creative agencies to publicly question how they'll justify hourly billing for work that now takes minutes. Agency leaders interviewed say they expect to shift toward value-based and retainer pricing.

title: India's AI talent market: salaries for ML engineers up 22% year-over-year, report finds
raw_summary: A compensation benchmarking report covering 400 Indian tech companies found average ML engineer salaries rose 22% over the past year, outpacing general software engineering roles. Bangalore and Hyderabad remain the top hiring hubs, with a growing share of roles now hybrid or fully remote.

title: Anthropic partners with three business schools to build AI-native MBA case studies
raw_summary: Anthropic announced a pilot program with three global business schools to co-develop case studies exploring AI adoption decisions, model governance, and competitive strategy. Students in the pilot will get access to Claude for structured case analysis exercises.
